needed.evidence: A narrow, trodden strip of ground serves as a path for pedestrians, with no formal sidewalk or pavement.
needed.suggestion: Construct a formal, paved sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe and dedicated space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The area to the right of the road is an informal, unpaved path with people sitting and standing on it, lacking a proper footway.
needed.suggestion: Build a continuous, paved footway on the right side of the road to separate pedestrians from traffic and provide a safe walking environment.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the left is partially obstructed by a parked auto-rickshaw and other vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Enforce a no-parking zone on the left side to keep the pedestrian path clear of vehicles and other obstructions.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right is obstructed by people sitting on the ground and various items, making it difficult to pass.
needed.suggestion: Install barriers or signage to prevent people from sitting and placing goods on the pedestrian path, ensuring it remains clear for passage.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the left appears uneven and has potential trip hazards from the lack of a proper surface.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left-side path with a smooth, even material to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: The informal path on the right is uneven and has objects on it, creating significant trip hazards for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the right-side path with a smooth, even material and remove any objects to eliminate trip hazards and improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: There is a high demand for crossing due to the presence of shops and a junction, but no formal crossing facility is visible.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing with a refuge island at the junction to provide a safe and visible place for people to cross the road.
